data.name: Jump Or Drown
data.detailed_description:
About This Game
Your pirate ship has shattered into splinters—and the sea doesn’t care. Stranded in open water, the only way to survive is to keep moving: leap from object to object across floating wreckage, drifting crates, and whatever else stays above the waves long enough to hold your weight. Every jump is a risk, every landing a relief, and every run a chance to do better.

Whether you’re playing alone or teaming up, your goal is simple: reach safety. How you get there is where the fun begins.

🌐 Online Party with Friends
Jump in with up to 6 players online and turn every run into chaos and laughter. Race side-by-side, recover from bad jumps, and push each other to take faster (and riskier) routes across the debris. It’s quick to pick up, easy to replay, and perfect for party sessions with friends.

🏆 Achievements Hunt
If you love ticking boxes and mastering challenges, there’s plenty to chase. Go for completion, try unusual playstyles, and earn achievements by taking on specific goals and pushing your skills beyond “just surviving.”

⏱️ Time Hunt
Think you’ve found the perfect route? Prove it. Compete for the best times, challenge friends, and refine every movement until your runs become clean, fast, and fearless. One missed jump can ruin a record—so every second counts.

🗺️ Chapters That Keep Getting Tougher
Progress through multiple chapters filled with new setups and surprises. As you advance, stages become more demanding—requiring sharper timing, smarter decision-making, and better control under pressure. The further you go, the more satisfying every successful run becomes.

data.short_description: A survival platformer for 1–6 players where you hop across floating wreckage after a pirate shipwreck—play solo or online with friends to race for safety, collect items, and earn achievements.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4 or AMD Athlon 64
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1920 x 1080 resolution
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
